name: Leung Lik Wai
source:
"Hey, don't mention it. Anything for you."

Ran Liwei, a low-level member of the Qingyun Society. He is a peddler and information broker, occasionally running minor errands for the Society. Idolizes [url=/c7177]Kong Taoluo[/url].
